outcome.technical: The affected selection is kept per tree identity. run-test-gate.py selection_key() hashes the reuse identity's own content digest (recorder paths excluded), the changed paths, meta_part, the task's gate step names and the bytes of the modules that make the selection; kept_selection() reads _affected_tests.read_selection() before gathering and keeps an answer only if the key is unchanged after the gathering. The store is <git common dir>/audit-selection (write_selection via _manifest_io.atomic_write_text, newest SELECTION_KEEP kept). affected_steps gained optional project and manifest_path; main passes them. Added OTHER_WRITERS row in tools/lints/_deps.py and guide paragraphs for _affected_tests.py and run-test-gate.py. Existing case ag7 adapted: a repeat's selection window now holds the key's time, not the gathering's. Cases sel1-sel10 (test_run_test_gate.py) and afs1-afs8 (test__affected_tests.py). Nine mutations each turned its case red and were restored with cmp: key omits meta (sel2), changed (sel3), content (sel4), code (sel10); recorder paths not excluded (sel5); stored though tree moved (sel9); store inside tree (sel6); never a hit (sel1); key unchecked on read (afs5). Measured on this repo, two cold runs 45 s apart: miss 15.45 s and 15.34 s, hit 0.10 s both. Gates after the last edit: ruff pass, vermin pass, full sweep 196/196 files ok, 20098 cases, exit 0.
outcome.descriptive: A second ask over the same tree reads the kept selection instead of recomputing it, saving about 15 s per repeated gate ask on this repo.
